tools.name: create_storyboard_preview
tools.description: Research a topic on Wikipedia and generate an 8–12 shot documentary opening storyboard with narration script, archive Wikimedia Commons CC-licensed images, maps and number cards (~25 seconds). Free (counts toward daily account preview limit).

tools.name: create_documentary_film
tools.description: Submit a full 1080p 16:9 narrated faceless documentary render (5 min = 25 credits, 10 min = 50 credits, 15 min = 75 credits). Returns film_id in queued state; poll get_documentary_film until completed.

tools.name: get_documentary_film
tools.description: Get the status of a documentary job by film_id (optionally waiting up to 50 seconds). When completed, returns a 1-hour MP4 download_url and description_text with Creative Commons image credits.

tools.name: cancel_documentary_film
tools.description: Cancel a queued documentary before rendering begins and release its held credits back to the account.

tools.name: get_credits
tools.description: Return available and held credits on this Hourlore account (5 credits = 1 minute of rendered film). Free.
